definition.label: Local network
definition.reason: An owned interface forwarder exposes only the selected loopback service to the local network.
unknowns: Current capability requires a successful probe from the intended client network.
Local network reach does not imply internet reach; firewall, routing and client DNS remain prerequisites.
This plan supplies HTTP only. HTTPS-required clients are denied; separately established trusted TLS needs a separately admitted listener plan.

reasons: HTTP is explicit; loopback binding is never advertised as LAN.

actions.label: Choose a local network interface
actions.reason: A loopback listener cannot serve other devices.

actions.label: Allow this listener through your firewall
actions.reason: Network exposure needs a deliberate scoped firewall decision; no automatic global rule.

actions.label: Choose a client-reachable name or IP
actions.reason: Use local DNS/mDNS only when proven from the client; an explicit checked interface IP also works.

actions.label: Configure a trusted certificate if HTTPS is required
actions.reason: Self-signed certificates are not automatically trusted.

admission.reason: Normalized HTTP plan; fresh exact selected-interface and scoped firewall approval permit allocation. Client reachability is established only after creation by a genuine remote LAN probe.

validation.tls: client-trusted certificate and exact hostname when HTTPS
validation.sse: timed incremental event delivery when required
validation.publish: exact-origin approval only after all required probes

lifecycle.stop: withdraw before cleanup; reconcile uncertain effects
lifecycle.networkVantage: LAN candidate remains validation-pending until genuine remote LAN peer receipt; name/mDNS or explicit reachable IP is a client choice, never inferred from host OS name.

detection.authority: Fresh exact interface binding and current-interface receipt; raw inventory alone does not prove client reach.

copy.consent: Expose this loopback service on the selected interface through an owned HTTP forwarder. Approve the exact firewall scope and prove the address from the intended LAN client.

human.name: lan
human.address: assigned on the selected network interface when it starts
human.setup: Choose --bind-address IP and approve it with --firewall-ack IP
